name: Paracetamol
usage: Used to relieve mild to moderate pain and fever. Take 1 tablet every 4-6 hours as needed.
sideEffects: Rare: nausea, allergic reactions, skin rash
warnings: Do not exceed 4000mg per day. Avoid if you have liver disease or consume alcohol heavily.
contraindications: Liver disease, severe alcohol abuse, hypersensitivity to paracetamol
dosageRecommendations: Adults: 500-1000mg, 3-4 times daily. Children: consult pharmacist

name: Ibuprofen
usage: Anti-inflammatory pain reliever for headaches, muscle pain, and fever.
warnings: Take with food. Do not use if allergic to NSAIDs. May increase risk of heart disease.
contraindications: Heart disease, stomach ulcers, kidney disease, hypertension

name: Aspirin
usage: Pain reliever and blood thinner. Used for minor pain, fever, and heart health.
warnings: Take with water or food. Not for children under 12 without doctor consent.
contraindications: Bleeding disorders, peptic ulcers, asthma, dengue

name: Amoxicillin
usage: Antibiotic for bacterial infections like ear, throat, and skin infections.
warnings: Complete the full course. May reduce effectiveness of oral contraceptives.
contraindications: Penicillin allergy, mononucleosis, severe kidney disease
dosageRecommendations: Adults: 250-500mg three times daily for 7-10 days

name: Azithromycin
usage: Broad-spectrum antibiotic for respiratory, skin, and soft tissue infections.
warnings: Do not use if allergic to macrolides. May cause QT prolongation.
contraindications: Macrolide allergy, liver disease, QT prolongation risk
dosageRecommendations: Adults: 500mg on day 1, then 250mg daily for 4 days

name: Cetirizine
usage: Antihistamine for allergies, hay fever, and itching.
warnings: May cause drowsiness; avoid driving. Take with or without food.
contraindications: Kidney disease, liver disease, hypersensitivity to cetirizine
dosageRecommendations: Adults: 10mg once daily in the evening

name: Crocin
usage: Pain and fever reliever. Used for headaches, body aches, and common cold.
warnings: Do not exceed recommended dose. Avoid if pregnant without doctor consent.
contraindications: Liver disease, alcohol abuse, paracetamol allergy
dosageRecommendations: Adults: 1-2 tablets every 4-6 hours. Max 3 tablets/day

name: Dolo 650
usage: Extended-relief pain and fever medication for moderate pain.
warnings: Take with milk or food. Do not break or crush tablet.
contraindications: Liver disease, kidney disease, alcohol abuse
dosageRecommendations: Adults: 1 tablet every 6-8 hours. Max 2 tablets/day

name: Metformin
usage: Diabetes medication to control blood sugar levels.
sideEffects: Stomach upset, metallic taste, diarrhea, B12 deficiency
warnings: Monitor kidney function. Avoid during acute illness or surgery.
contraindications: Severe kidney disease, liver disease, heart failure, contrast dye allergy

name: Atorvastatin
usage: Cholesterol-lowering statin for heart disease prevention.
sideEffects: Muscle pain, liver damage, high blood sugar
warnings: Regular liver function tests recommended. Avoid grapefruit juice.
contraindications: Pregnancy, active liver disease, high liver enzymes
dosageRecommendations: Adults: 10-80mg once daily in the evening

name: Vitamin C
usage: Immune system booster for cold prevention and wound healing.
sideEffects: GI upset, kidney stones (high doses), diarrhea
warnings: Do not exceed 2000mg/day. May interfere with certain blood tests.
contraindications: Kidney stones, glucose-6-phosphate deficiency, iron overload

name: Vitamin D3
usage: Bone health, calcium absorption, and immune function.
warnings: Monitor calcium levels if taking high doses. Limit sun exposure not needed.
contraindications: Hypercalcemia, vitamin D toxicity, sarcoidosis

name: Iron Tablets
usage: Treats iron deficiency anemia and improves oxygen transport.
sideEffects: Constipation, dark stools, nausea, abdominal discomfort
warnings: Take on empty stomach or with orange juice. Store away from children.
contraindications: Hemochromatosis, thalassemia, sickle cell disease

name: Zinc Tablets
usage: Immune system support and wound healing.
warnings: Do not exceed 40mg/day. Not for long-term use without monitoring.
contraindications: Copper deficiency, certain infections

name: ORS
usage: Oral rehydration solution for diarrhea, vomiting, and dehydration.
warnings: Mix with clean water. Use within 24 hours after mixing.
contraindications: Severe dehydration (needs IV), unconsciousness
dosageRecommendations: Sip small amounts frequently or as directed by doctor

name: Antacid
usage: Relieves acidity, heartburn, and indigestion.
warnings: Do not use for prolonged periods. Take separately from other medicines.
contraindications: Kidney disease, high calcium levels
dosageRecommendations: Adults: 1-2 tablets as needed. Max 7-8 tablets/day

name: Pantoprazole
usage: Reduces stomach acid for GERD, ulcers, and acid reflux.
sideEffects: Headache, nausea, diarrhea, vitamin B12 deficiency
warnings: Take 30 minutes before food. Long-term use may affect calcium absorption.
contraindications: Severe liver disease, vitamin B12 deficiency

name: Omeprazole
usage: Proton pump inhibitor for severe acid reflux and ulcer treatment.
warnings: May mask symptoms of stomach cancer. Not for long-term self-use.
contraindications: Severe liver disease, suspected gastric malignancy

name: Losartan
usage: Blood pressure reducer for hypertension management.
sideEffects: Dizziness, fatigue, cough, high potassium levels
warnings: Monitor kidney function and potassium levels. Avoid NSAIDs.
contraindications: Pregnancy, kidney disease, potassium deficiency

name: Amlodipine
usage: Calcium channel blocker for blood pressure and angina management.
warnings: Avoid grapefruit juice. May take 2-3 weeks to show full effect.
contraindications: Severe aortic stenosis, cardiogenic shock
